title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Accounts Assistant
- Location: Warrington (Hybrid working)
- Pay: £31,000 - £34,000 per annum
- Full-Time Permanent Position

About the Role:

We are seeking an experienced Accounts Assistant to join our client's finance team on a permanent basis. This is a fantastic opportunity for someone with strong organisational skills, excellent attention to detail, and a desire to develop their accounting career within a supportive and collaborative environment.

Key Responsibilities:
- Processing a high volume of purchase invoices accurately and efficiently
- Managing supplier accounts and resolving invoice queries
- Preparing and processing weekly and monthly payment runs
- Performing bank reconciliations and investigating any discrepancies
- Assisting with month-end procedures and balance sheet reconciliations
- Maintaining accurate financial records and updating the finance system
- Supporting with expenses, statement reconciliations, and other general accounts administration duties
- Providing wider support to the finance team as required

Requirements:
- Previous experience within an Accounts Assistant or Accounts Payable position
- Good understanding of purchase ledger processes and bank reconciliations
- Strong attention to detail and ability to manage workloads effectively
- Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and finance systems
- Excellent communication skills and ability to work collaboratively within a team

My client has advised that full training and ongoing support will be provided for the successful candidate. This is a fantastic opportunity to join a leading organisation and further develop your finance career. Please do not hesitate to apply.

title: Accounts Assistant
description:
We are pleased to be working a well established SME Business located in Warrington who are looking for a senior accounts assistant to join them on a full time, permanent basis. This role will be reporting into the financial controller within the company, and will take responsibility of all the transactional elements of accounts.

Duties will include:
- Maintaining all aspects of purchase ledger and liaise with suppliers.
- Ensuring correct authorisation and coding of high volume purchase invoices
- Reconcile supplier statements.
- Ensuring suppliers are paid according to agreement terms and conditions.
- Process employee expenses, wages and dealing with HMRC and pensions etc.
- Weekly payment runs.
- Bank and account reconciliations
- Administration duties and demands of the business.

Benefits:
- 25 days holiday + bank holidays
- Full time permanent role - Monday-Friday
- Hybrid working
- Parking on site
- Company pension scheme
- Study support for AAT

title: Payroll Assistant
description:
An exciting opportunity has arisen for a Payroll Advisor on an interim basis for a growing business. This is an interim opportunity, with long-term prospects to move permanent.

Client Details

Our client is a well-established business, currently seeking a Payroll Advisor to join their team in Warrington on an interim basis. This role offers the opportunity to gain valuable experience within a busy payroll function, with the potential to become a permanent position for the right candidate.

Description

The Payroll Advisor duties include:
- Supporting the monthly and weekly payroll cycles
- Reviewing payroll data for accuracy and resolving discrepancies before submission
- Handling payroll-related enquiries from employees and managers
- Assisting with statutory payments, pension contributions and compliance activities
- Working closely with HR and Finance to ensure employee records remain up to date
- Contributing to payroll process improvements and system enhancements

Profile

A successful Payroll Administrator should have:
- Previous experience working in a payroll position, ideally as a Payroll Administrator, Payroll Assistant or Payroll Advisor
- A strong eye for detail with the ability to work accurately in a fast-paced environment
- Good understanding of payroll legislation
- Strong communication skills
- Able to prioritise workload and manage competing deadlines effectively

Job Offer

The benefits include:
- Salary £28,000-£35,000 depending on experience
- Temporary position possibility to go permanent
- Free on-site parking
- Hybrid working after passed training
- 37.5 hour working weel

title: Payroll Assistant
description:
Payroll Assistant (Temporary 3-6 Month Contract)
- Location: Warrington (Hybrid Working)
- Salary: £14.87 - £17.44 per hour DOE
- Contract: Temporary, 3-6 Months
- Start Date: ASAP
- Reporting To: Payroll Manager

We are currently recruiting for a Payroll Assistant to join a well-established organisation based in Warrington on a temporary basis for an initial 3-6-month period.

Key Responsibilities
- Assisting with the processing of monthly payroll information.
- Maintaining accurate employee payroll records and data.
- Processing starters, leavers and employee amendments.
- Supporting the administration of statutory payments including sickness, maternity and paternity pay.
- Handling payroll-related queries from employees and managers.
- Assisting with pension administration activities.
- Producing payroll reports and supporting data analysis.

Requirements
- Previous experience within a payroll, payroll administration or finance administration position.
- Strong attention to detail and numerical accuracy.
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and other Microsoft Office applications.
- Excellent communication and customer service skills.
- The ability to manage workloads and work to strict deadlines.

If you are an experienced Payroll Assistant or Payroll Administrator available at short notice and looking for your next opportunity in Warrington, we'd love to hear from you.
